title: Eleven Words Available Since 1961
subtitle: 法律规则 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 法律规则（社会服务与人际沟通·法律与规则）
meta: 主题语境：法律规则（社会服务与人际沟通·法律与规则）　|　核心词汇：truth　|　正文 360 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 truth 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: The ① truth, as the court finally heard it in 1974, was eleven words long and had been available since 1961, and the only reason it took thirteen years is that nobody had asked my grandfather, who had been standing in the room the whole time. He ② told the truth twice, once to the police and once to the court, and both times they wrote down something else. He said the truth is a thing you have to carry until somebody asks for it.

③ To tell you the truth, I do not think anybody was lying; I think eleven people each wrote down what they expected to hear. The ④ truth is that expectation is stronger than evidence and always has been, and my grandfather said afterwards that he had not been disbelieved, he had been unheard, which is a different thing and a worse one.

⑤ In truth the case was decided before it opened, in a windowless room, by two men who never met him. There is ⑥ some truth in what the defence said about the light: it was November, it was six o'clock, and nobody could have seen a face at eleven metres. But the ⑦ truth he cared about, and for which the law has no word, is that being in the room is not the same as knowing what happened in it.

In 1989 the ⑧ truth of that statement was finally tested: the police note had been typed two days after the interview, from memory, by a man who had not been in the room, and three sentences in it were things my grandfather had never said. The ⑨ truth, when the court accepted it, changed nothing: eleven years had gone, and the man who had gone to prison for it had died in 1981, at sixty-one, in another county.

My grandfather died in 1998 and never once said he had been right. The ⑩ truth I have lived with since, and I am not proud of it, is that I believed the note before I believed him, and the truth of it is that I never asked; I was eleven, and I had been in the house that night too.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 真相；事实；实情
B. n. （陈述、证据的）真实性；可靠性
C. n. 真理；道理；实理
D. 固定搭配：tell the truth 说真话；讲出实情
E. 固定搭配：to tell (you) the truth 说实话；老实告诉你
F. 固定搭配：the truth is (that) ... 事实是……
G. 固定搭配：in truth 事实上；其实
H. 固定搭配：there is (some) truth in ... ……不无道理／有几分真实

items.q: The truth, as the court finally heard it
To tell you the truth, I do not think
The truth is that expectation is stronger
In truth the case was decided
There is some truth in what the defence said
the truth of that statement was finally tested
The truth, when the court accepted it
The truth I have lived with since

answers.why: the truth 意为“真相、实情”，1974 年法庭终于听到的真相只有十一个字，而它从 1961 年起就摆在那里。
tell the truth 意为“说真话、讲出实情”，他讲过两次实情，一次对警察，一次对法庭。
to tell you the truth 意为“说实话、老实告诉你”，老实说，我认为没有人撒谎。
the truth is (that) ... 意为“事实是……”，事实是，预期比证据更有力量，历来如此。
in truth 意为“事实上、其实”，其实这个案子在开庭之前就已经定了。
there is some truth in ... 意为“……不无道理、有几分真实”，辩护方关于光线的说法并非没有道理。
the truth 意为“道理、实理”，他在意的那个道理是：人在现场不等于知道现场发生了什么。
the truth of that statement 意为“那份陈述的真实性、可靠性”，1989 年那份陈述的真实性终于受到了检验。
the truth 意为“真相”，法庭接受了这个真相，却什么也没有改变。
the truth 意为“（我不得不面对的）事实”，此后我一直带着的这个事实是：我先信了那份笔录。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1974 年法庭终于听到的真相只有十一个字。（truth）
他讲过两次实情，而两次他们记下的都是别的东西。（tell the truth）
老实说，我认为没有人撒谎，只是每个人记下了自己预期会听到的话。（to tell you the truth）
事实是，预期比证据更有力量，历来如此。（the truth is that）
其实这个案子在开庭之前就已经定了，在一间没有窗的屋子里。（in truth）
辩护方关于光线的说法并非没有道理：那是十一月，六点钟。（there is some truth in）
answers: The truth, as the court finally heard it in 1974, was eleven words long.
He told the truth twice, and both times they wrote down something else.
To tell you the truth, I do not think anybody was lying; each wrote down what they expected to hear.
The truth is that expectation is stronger than evidence, and always has been.
In truth the case was decided before it opened, in a windowless room.
There is some truth in what the defence said about the light: it was November, it was six o'clock.
